about: V1's live Special Moves (RPG-game trunk 82a994d15), the melee kind V1's beta gives the player. A press within `reach` commits a cast (nothing spent out of reach); the cast winds up `windup` ticks (sandbox specialMeleeWindup), during which no other action is legal; on release it lands `share` of the target's max health, unblockable and undodgeable, unless the target has left reach+slack (fizzles); the victim staggers, is shoved and shaken by the skill's move row scaled by `react` percent (sandbox specialReact*). The caster can't attack for `recovery` ticks. Damage taken during the windup adds up: at interruptAt of max health the cast is cut (lockout = interruptCooldown x (1 + early x ticks left / windup / 1000)); a lesser hit pushes the release back `pushback` ticks, at most pushbackMax times. Timers are RV80's live rows (rows80-defs.json): ready `first` ticks into a fight, then `cooldown` between casts, each slot its own (spell-slot-defs sharedCooldown 0). Slots: career-rules.json:87 betaCut slot defaults; the full pick list is sandbox-rules-defs.json:341-366. Sources: duel.ts:363-380 (cast), 641-692 (release), 740-760 (interrupt); rules-defs.json:28-37.
